reviews.text: I have seen all 4 veterinarians with my shi tzu, and they are all wonderful. Caring, smart, and they really take the time to listen and answer all my concerns. This practice is a hidden treasure of Williamsburg.

It pains me to leave a negative review for a vet I trusted for years, but after several recent experiences, the practice has begun to feel increasingly transactional and less compassionate than the place I had known.

I’ve encountered repeated unexpected and significant unforseen charges, including additional vaccines after comprehensive annual visits and a costly travel-document appointment despite asking about pricing beforehand. I have not left the practice without spending at least $500 for routine appointments. I understand veterinary care can be expensive; my concern is the lack of transparency and the feeling that each visit increasingly comes with another charge or service I wasn’t anticipating.

Update: What happened after posting this review was even more disappointing. Three days before an international trip, the practice revoked my dog’s travel documents, leaving me scrambling for an alternative. Afterward, someone who had been present and overheard the conversation independently reached out to me because they were concerned by how the situation was handled so "spitefully" and wanted to help. I believe an employee given I'm not sure how they were able to obtain my number?

After years of trusting this practice with my dog, I never expected a negative review to be followed by something that felt so punitive and unprofessional, particularly when it affected my ability to travel with him days later. I genuinely wish this had been handled with more compassion.

I absolutely love this vet. Dr Leiman is so knowledgeable, always walks me through what he’s checking for and assessing, and i have so much confidence in his answers. I switched to this vet cause i felt like the one i was going to was scammy and i am so glad i did.

I’ve been taking my cats to Northside for 8 years. They are very caring and knowledgeable. They Check in after appointments when the cats are sick and are helpful in getting them into the vet sooner if needed.
Everyone here is so welcoming and professional. They take the most careful care of our pets. Definitely recommend over the gentrifying chain vets around the neighborhood.

Christopher, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Northside Veterinary Clinic! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!
Phenomenal service! The receptionists were SO kind, and the vet was patient, friendly, knowledgeable, and very gentle with my cat! Amazing, and I would recommend. My cat loved it too!
Hello Szalab, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Hello Cassidy, your support means a lot — thank you for the positive review!
Hello Madeline, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
Dr. Lippmann is both a mensch and an ubermensch!
Kelly, thank you so much for your positive review! We strive to provide top-notch care for all our furry patients.

Northside vet were recommended by my trainer, and as a dog groomer I will suggest to always listen to those who really care about furry friends. She was absolutely right on how caring and loving they were with my Bernedoodle puppy. They are very professional and very informative.

Had the worst experience here, over a year ago but it still sticks out to me. Brought in my sassy 6 month kitten, who the vet called a “monster” & “little weasel”. She’s def a character but this is my baby who sleeps w me every night, maybe have a little consideration

Then they hadn’t verified test results so had me calling previous vet during the appt, while they were scruffing my kitten who was freaking out. Couldn’t take her blood, I stupidly reached out to comfort her & got bit, but I’d never seen her that distressed before. Vet came back in, said “oh we use no fear tactics, no scruffing”, didnt bother to tell her her own assistant apparently didn’t know that as I’d just watch her do it. No compassion or concern, the only folks who were caring were the receptionists who gave me a tissue.

If you don’t have the skills to handle a sassy lil 6 month old kitten maybe look into that, likely traumatized her & made future vet appts harder. She’s doing great now btw, opinionated as ever but communicates it great, & so sweet & playful
The best vet in Williamsburg--easy to get an appointment. Clean and runs on schedule. We love both Dr. Leimans! We have been loyal to Northside for 20 years with all of our dogs.
It really feels like they care. Use a local veterinary clinic whenever you can. Dr. Stacy is amazing.
Dr. Leiman is incredible and so is the rest of the team. We have been to many vets all over the country with our three dogs and we LOVE Northside.
The entire staff is genuinely friendly and accommodating. Dr.Stacy Leiman is outstanding.
This office is filled with caring people who are competent and kind.
Alex, thank you so much for review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!
Everyone at this veterinary office is so kind, welcoming, and intelligent.  Everyone hear truly loves all animals.  I enjoy our vet appointments.

Splendor, we’re so glad to know you had a wonderful experience at Northside Veterinary Clinic! Our team is dedicated to giving every pet the best care possible, and it means a lot to see that reflected in your review. Thank you for your support!
we love every doctor we’ve seen here! a very human and animal lover approach. so happy they’re nearby.
Hello Maryana, Thank you for taking the time to rate us!
Lovely staff, my dog had a great experience.
Hi Erin, Thank you for the positive review! Our team sincerely appreciates it!
Really nice staff, and excellent care.

Great experience. The vets genuinely care for my pet. My previous vet was fine, but I felt like they wanted money for everything. I emailed them asking what food my dog should be eating and they wanted to charge me to answer the question. Crazy. These guys are different. They just want me dog to be healthy.
my cats are both peovided w/ care here and i am proud.
We've been a patient for 8 yrs, always take great care of my dog!
Excellent place. The doctors here are thoughtful, caring and kind to our furry friends. Highly recommend

Had a great first time visit here. Dr. Stacey and the team were very gentle with my 12 year old cat, and were also very thorough. I did not feel rushed at all and all questions were answered. We left feeling calm and relieved. Would definitely return.

Stone age! I was not allowed to attend my dog’s ultrasound because they had no “enough room” for me lol we waited more than an hour and 20 mins before the person arrived to do ultrasound. When everything was done they did not even tell us number of puppies lol and they asked to wait up to two days. Absolutely stone age. If you don't have enough room for pet owners don't do ultrasound then, and if y o u send ultrasound results after puppies are born then let owners know so they won't pay $650 dollars. Unbelievable. Last time there, never going back!
Hello Warren, your support means a lot — thank you for the positive review!
Had the best experience with Dr. Leiman and everyone at Northside during a stressful time with my cat. They provided great care and spotted an unusual pattern in my cat that probably saved his life.
Hello Chloe, thank you for the positive review — we’re glad to have your support!
Terriweagant, thank you so much for your positive review! We strive to provide top-notch care for all our furry patients.
Always a wonderful experience! Dr.Leiman and the rest of the staff are so helpful and caring! I couldn't ask for a better Veterinary office!

Dr. Leiman was so kind when I brought in my senior cat near the end of her life. He handled her so gently, and did an amazing job of calming both her and me. His treatment gave us a few more months together, and when it was eventually time, the whole staff couldn’t have been more compassionate and caring. Highly recommend this vet.

There’s no other vet I’d ever take my pup to except for Dr. Leiman and the whole north side veterinary staff. Throughout our experience they’ve been patient in explaining complex issues, thorough in their tests, and poised when delivering hard news. 10/10
So thankful for this whole team at Northside for showing such compassion and care for my little guy Mickey. I wouldn’t trust anyone else! The kindest and most welcoming highly recommend!!
John-paul, thank you! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have you as part of our Northside Veterinary Clinic family.

10/10. We’ve been clients for over eight years, and I can’t say enough amazing things about this practice. The entire team is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about every animal that comes through their doors.
Whenever I go they welcome me like family, they already have a relationship with my dog ​​and they are very kind and understanding.

I am extremely disappointed with the care my dog received at Northside Veterinary Clinic. When I brought her in with concerning symptoms related to her kidneys, I expected a thorough evaluation and prompt action. Unfortunately, the clinic failed to recognize the severity of her condition and did not refer her to a specialist or hospital for the urgent care she desperately needed.

This lack of action not only compromised her health but also caused unnecessary stress and worry for my family. I trusted them with my pet's well-being, and they let us down. I cannot recommend this clinic based on my experience.

We almost lost her. Thank you to the staff at Veterinary Care Group for saving her life and providing the proper treatment needed.

The care our Harold receives from Northside and Dr. Stacy Leiman is extraordinary. He is a precious 16 years old now and Dr. Leiman has made the best recommendations for him in terms of chiropractics and acupuncture to keep him incredibly fit and able to enjoy his body at this senior age. We are so grateful to have found Northside and it’s a very special place.
It's always a great experience here and my cat is at ease.

One of the most painful parts of losing our dog was not just saying goodbye, but how those final moments were handled. Before she had even been euthanized, we were given an urn selection sheet with no prices listed and asked whether we wanted the credit card machine brought into the room. In the last moments we had with our dog, we were asked to make financial decisions and complete a transaction instead of being given space to simply be with her.

I want to be clear that this is not a statement that Dr. Leiman did not care. The issue is that compassionate care extends beyond medicine and includes protecting families during their most vulnerable moments. I am disappointed to see Northside state that it is not private equity-owned without acknowledging its affiliation with Veterinary Practice Partners, which is backed by Audax Private Equity. Acknowledging how these processes impact grieving families would have meant far more than defending the practice.
Wouldn’t take my beloved Vinny anywhere else. He legitimately tugs on his leash like crazy to get in the door, he loves it.

Losing our dog was heartbreaking, but our experience felt like money came before compassion. Even when another veterinarian wanted Dr. Eisner’s input, we were told we had to pay for another appointment instead of the doctors discussing the case together. Before our dog was even euthanized, we were asked to choose an urn and whether we wanted the credit card machine brought into the room. In our experience, this practice was far more focused on billing than caring. They are owned by private equity, so increasing margins will always be their first priority.
